title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a semantic search interface to find reusable code patterns and architectures across a user's portfolio.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the backend API, and static HTML/JS for the frontend. It uses GitHub Actions for automated weekly reindexing and AWS S3/CloudFront for hosting.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories using the CLI, and serve the web UI or deploy to AWS.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across repository READMEs
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
MCP server integration for AI agent access to portfolio data
Static web UI with autocomplete and shareable search URLs
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
